The Kamayurai are one of 13 or so single-village groups living in the area of the headwaters of the Xingu River, a major southern tributary of the Amazon in Central Brazil. text: In phonology, the phoneme inventories are compared and the sound changes are listed that occurred from the hypothetical proto-language “Proto-Maweti-Guarani” to Aweti, on the one hand, and to Proto-Tupi-Guarani and further to Kamayurá, on the other.
